task_fulfillment.rationale: Both Word deliverables substantially address the requested escalation and replacement decision, with correct base-cost calculations and a specific Vendrax recommendation. Material corrections are needed before use: unsupported FX scenarios/pass-through, definite launch-recovery claims despite missing development timing, and an assumed paid/refunded amount used in both the external notice and transition funding. The nomination confirmation and ET/QT condition are reasonable, not unnecessary holds. No separate change route, action schedule or companion spreadsheet was supplied; the embedded conditions, payment schedule, routing and companion email were inspected. Page counts and visual usability remain unverified and are not the basis of this failure.
